g.text: DA n FDR-hit HDBSCAN clusters by sex x condition
(21 models; one rep syllable/cluster; BH across clusters within cell)
Alphabet = HDBSCAN cluster_id (noise excluded). Per model: max-n_bouts
raw_syllable_id per cluster. Wilcoxon Δp vs 0 within condition x sex;
BH across clusters in model x session x step x condition x sex. Not
the same as syllable-alphabet n-hit (different family size).
